requirements.title: Turn the code index on in the configuration
requirements.rationale: An operator decides whether the hub spends disk and CPU on indexes, and how much.

criteria.condition: the configuration has a [code_index] section
criteria.action: read max_files, max_size, build_timeout and workers from the section, each with its default (100000, "1GB", "5m", 2) when absent, and build indexes with them

check.pseudocode: in a new internal/config/codeindex_test.go, as internal/config/scm_test.go does for [scm]: a table {an empty [code_index] → enabled with 100000, 1<<30, 5m, 2; every key set → those values; no section → not enabled}

criteria.condition: [code_index] holds an unknown key, a max_files below 1, a workers outside 1 to 16, or a max_size or build_timeout that cannot be read or is not positive
criteria.action: refuse the configuration at static validation, together with the hub's other configuration failures
criteria.contract: the start fails before the hub listens; the message names the key as code_index.<key> and says what is accepted

check.pseudocode: in internal/config/codeindex_test.go, a table {unknown = 1, max_files = 0, workers = 0, workers = 17, max_size = "big", max_size = "0GB", build_timeout = "soon", build_timeout = "0s"}: the load fails with a message holding the key; a configuration with a bad [code_index] key and a bad [scm] key fails with both messages

criteria.condition: the configuration has [code_index] and the index cannot run on the platform (agentkit-go's codesearch answers ErrUnsupported)
criteria.action: refuse to start
criteria.contract: the start fails before the hub listens with one message that says the code index is not supported on this platform and names [code_index]

check.pseudocode: in a new internal/codeindex test file: the component's start check, given a constructor that returns codesearch.ErrUnsupported, returns an error whose message holds [code_index] and the platform; with the real constructor on this platform it returns nil; without [code_index] the check is not run

criteria.condition: the configuration has no [code_index] section
criteria.action: build no tree and no index, register no build, create no directory for the code index under the data directory, and leave the outline route and every other route as they are

check.pseudocode: in a new internal/codeindex test file, with a hub of hubtest.Start (no [code_index]) and a workspace with commits: after a commit to main and a maintenance pass, the data directory holds no code index directory, the job queue holds no job of type code_index, and parley_code_index_builds_total is 0 for every outcome

requirements.title: Turn one workspace off with a setting
requirements.rationale: Not every repository is worth an index; its owner says so where the workspace's other settings are.

criteria.action: for any repository workspace, show the setting code_index in its settings with the default true, store a boolean given for it, and show a fork its parent's value

check.pseudocode: in internal/workspace/settings_test.go, code_index added to the table of TestSettings_ShowsEveryKeyWithItsStoredValueOrItsDefault (default true) and to TestSettings_StoresAValueItsKeyAcceptsAndRefusesAnyOther (true and false stored; "yes", 1 and {} refused naming the key); in the fork's settings test of internal/fork, a fork of a parent with code_index false shows false; the setting is there with and without [code_index]

criteria.condition: the setting code_index of a workspace is turned off
criteria.action: remove the workspace's tree and index and its pending build within one maintenance pass, and end a build of it that is running

check.pseudocode: in a new internal/codeindex test file, with a hub of hubtest.StartWith whose Config.TOML holds [code_index]: demo is indexed; PATCH /workspaces/demo with settings {code_index: false}; after one maintenance pass (the hub's maintenance loop, driven by Config.MaintenanceInterval) the code index directory holds nothing of demo and the queue no code_index job of demo; a second pass changes nothing

criteria.condition: the setting code_index of a workspace is turned on
criteria.action: queue a build of the workspace

check.pseudocode: in a new internal/codeindex test file, with a hub of hubtest.StartWith whose Config.TOML holds [code_index]: demo has code_index false and no index; PATCH settings {code_index: true}; without any commit, the index of demo reaches the head of main; setting it to true when it is already true queues nothing

requirements.title: Build the tree and the index of the default branch's head
requirements.rationale: The index is only worth having if it holds exactly the commit it says it holds, and a build can never harm the hub or the previous index.

criteria.condition: a build of a workspace runs
criteria.action: write the files of the head commit of the workspace's default branch, as it is when the build starts, into the workspace's tree, build the index from the tree, and record the commit as the indexed commit with the number of files indexed and the time

check.pseudocode: in a new internal/codeindex test file, with a hub of hubtest.StartWith whose Config.TOML holds [code_index]: demo's main holds a.go, docs/b.md and an executable run.sh; once the build ended, the tree holds exactly those files with their content and run.sh executable, and the component's record of demo has indexed_sha == head of main, files_indexed == 3 and built_at set; after a commit that removes a.go and adds c.go and its build, the tree holds docs/b.md, run.sh and c.go and the record the new head

criteria.action: for any commit, keep in the tree its files and nothing else: no .git, no content of a submodule, a symbolic link as a link that is never followed, no hook run and no filter or attribute applied

check.pseudocode: in a new internal/codeindex test file, with a hub of hubtest.StartWith whose Config.TOML holds [code_index]: main holds a symbolic link out -> /etc/hosts, a link loop -> ., a gitlink at vendor/lib, a .gitattributes that names a filter and an eol conversion for *.txt with a CRLF file, and a repository hook post-checkout that would write a marker: after the build the tree has no .git, vendor/lib is absent or an empty directory, out and loop are symbolic links with their targets as committed, the .txt file's bytes equal the blob's, and the marker does not exist

criteria.condition: max_files, max_size or build_timeout stops a build
criteria.action: keep the index with what it holds, mark it partial, and count the build as partial

check.pseudocode: in a new internal/codeindex test file, a table {max_files = 2 with five files; max_size = "1KB" with files of 4 KB; build_timeout = "1ms" with a build held past it through the component's seam}: the record of demo has partial true and indexed_sha the head; parley_code_index_builds_total{outcome="partial"} is 1; the build is not retried while the head stays

criteria.condition: a build fails for a reason other than a bound
criteria.action: leave the previous index and its record in place, record the failure, and retry the build with the queue's growing delays
criteria.contract: the index of the commit built before stays usable and its indexed_sha unchanged; the failure's text is kept for the status route; the job is retried as every job of the queue is

check.pseudocode: in a new internal/codeindex test file, with a hub of hubtest.StartWith whose Config.TOML holds [code_index] and a job clock (hubtest.NewJobClock): demo is indexed at commit A; the head moves to B and the build fails through the component's seam: the record still has indexed_sha A, the failure is recorded, parley_code_index_builds_total{outcome="failed"} is 1 and the job waits; advancing the clock by the queue's first delay runs the build again, which succeeds and records B

criteria.condition: the head of the default branch moves while a failed build waits for its retry
criteria.action: run the build of the new head at once, without waiting for the failed build's next attempt

check.pseudocode: in a new internal/codeindex test file, with a hub of hubtest.StartWith whose Config.TOML holds [code_index] and a job clock: the build of B failed and waits for its delay; a commit moves main to C; without advancing the clock, the index reaches C

criteria.action: for any number of queued builds, run at most [code_index].workers of them at once

check.pseudocode: in a new internal/codeindex test file, with a hub of hubtest.StartWith whose Config.TOML holds [code_index] with workers = 2 and builds held through the component's seam: five workspaces get a build queued; exactly two are running while three stay queued; releasing one starts a third

requirements.title: Queue a build whenever the head moves
requirements.rationale: A search must be able to rely on the index following the default branch whatever moved it.

criteria.condition: a repository workspace is created
criteria.action: queue a build of the workspace once it has its repository

check.pseudocode: in a new internal/codeindex test file, with a hub of hubtest.StartWith whose Config.TOML holds [code_index]: POST /workspaces creates demo from a local origin; without any further request, the index of demo reaches the head of its default branch

criteria.condition: the head of a workspace's default branch moves, by whatever route: a land, a push, a sync, a commit or a ref move through the source control API, a rebuild or a reclone
criteria.action: queue a build of the workspace

check.pseudocode: in a new test of test/e2e, with the hubs of the land, sync, source control write, rebuild and reclone tests, a table over the route {a land of a change, a git push to main, a sync that fast-forwards main, POST …/scm/commits on main, PATCH …/scm/refs/heads/main, a rebuild of a carry-patch workspace, a reclone}: after the route, GET …/scm/code-index reaches state ready with indexed_sha equal to the new head; a write to another branch than the default branch queues nothing

criteria.action: for any workspace, keep at most one pending build beside the one that is running, and when the head moved while a build ran, run one more build that takes the head as it is then

check.pseudocode: in a new internal/codeindex test file, with a hub of hubtest.StartWith whose Config.TOML holds [code_index] and builds held through the component's seam: while the build of A is held, three commits move main to B, C and D: the queue holds one running and one queued code_index job of demo; released, the first build records A and the second D; no build of B or C ran (parley_code_index_builds_total is 2)

criteria.condition: the hub starts
criteria.action: queue a build for every enabled workspace whose index is not at the head of its default branch, and none for a workspace whose index is

check.pseudocode: in a new internal/codeindex test file, with a hub of hubtest.StartWith whose Config.TOML holds [code_index]: demo is indexed at A and other at its head; the hub is stopped, a commit is written to demo's repository directly, moving main to B, and the hub is started again (Hub.Restart): demo's index reaches B and no build of other ran

criteria.action: for any maintenance pass, queue a build for every enabled workspace whose index is not at its head and that has no pending build, and remove the tree and index of every workspace that does not exist any more or is not enabled

check.pseudocode: in a new internal/codeindex test file, with a hub of hubtest.StartWith whose Config.TOML holds [code_index]: the record of demo is set back to an older commit and a directory of a workspace that does not exist is put under the code index directory; after one maintenance pass demo's index is at its head again and the stray directory is gone

requirements.title: Keep the index for as long as the workspace, and across restarts
requirements.rationale: An index that is rebuilt at every start makes the first search after a deploy slow for everyone; one that outlives its workspace leaks its content.

criteria.condition: the hub restarts
criteria.action: have the index of every workspace whose head did not move, at the same indexed commit, without building it again

check.pseudocode: in a new internal/codeindex test file, with a hub of hubtest.StartWith whose Config.TOML holds [code_index]: demo is indexed at A; Hub.Restart; the record of demo is at A with the same built_at, the index answers a query for a word of a.go through the component, and parley_code_index_builds_total is 0 after the restart

criteria.condition: a workspace is archived
criteria.action: keep the workspace's tree and index

check.pseudocode: in a new internal/codeindex test file, with a hub of hubtest.StartWith whose Config.TOML holds [code_index]: demo is indexed; POST /workspaces/demo/archive; after a maintenance pass the tree and the record of demo are as before

criteria.condition: a workspace is deleted
criteria.action: remove its pending builds in the delete's transaction, end a build of it that is running, and remove its tree and index from the disk

check.pseudocode: in a new internal/codeindex test file, with a hub of hubtest.StartWith whose Config.TOML holds [code_index]: demo is indexed and has a build held through the component's seam; DELETE /workspaces/demo: the queue holds no code_index job of demo, the held build's context ends, and the code index directory holds nothing of demo once the delete has answered and one maintenance pass ran; a workspace created again under the slug demo gets an index of its own head

criteria.action: for any fork, keep no tree and no index and queue no build, whatever moves its refs

check.pseudocode: in a new internal/codeindex test file, with a hub of hubtest.StartWith whose Config.TOML holds [code_index]: a fork demo--x of demo is created and a commit pushed to its branch: the queue holds no code_index job of demo--x and the code index directory nothing of it

requirements.title: Show the state of a workspace's index
requirements.rationale: Whoever waits for a search, or wonders why one is slow, needs to see which commit the index holds and whether a build is under way or failed.

criteria.condition: a caller requests GET /workspaces/:slug/scm/code-index
criteria.action: answer with the state of the workspace's index: whether it is enabled, its state, the head of the default branch, and the indexed commit with whether it is partial, how many files it holds and when it was built
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with {"workspace", "enabled", "state", "head_sha", "indexed_sha", "partial", "files_indexed", "built_at", "error"}; state is one of off, queued, building, ready, failed; built_at is RFC 3339 or null; error is null unless the last build failed

check.pseudocode: in a new internal/codeindex test file, through the hub's router, a table over the situation {indexed at the head → ready; a build held → building; the head moved and the build not yet claimed → queued; the last build of the head failed → failed with error; a partial index → ready with partial true; no repository yet → queued with head_sha and indexed_sha null}: the answer's members equal the situation's, indexed_sha and files_indexed describing the index there is in every state

criteria.condition: the hub has no [code_index] or the workspace's setting code_index is off
criteria.action: answer 200 with enabled false and state off, and with what is left of an index, which is nothing after a maintenance pass

check.pseudocode: in a new internal/codeindex test file, a table {a hub without [code_index]; a hub with it and demo's code_index false}: 200, enabled false, state off, indexed_sha null

criteria.condition: the request is addressed to a fork
criteria.action: answer for the fork's parent and say so
criteria.contract: workspace is the parent's slug; every other member is the parent's

check.pseudocode: in a new internal/codeindex test file, with a hub of hubtest.StartWith whose Config.TOML holds [code_index]: GET /workspaces/demo--x/scm/code-index by a caller who may read the fork answers 200 with workspace "demo" and the members of demo's own status

criteria.action: for any failed build, show its failure with every secret the hub scrubs removed and cut to 1,024 bytes

check.pseudocode: in a new internal/codeindex test file: a build fails with an error of 5,000 bytes that holds a registered secret: the status's error is at most 1,024 bytes and does not hold the secret

criteria.action: for any request to the route, apply the access rule of the source control reads (a PAT needs git:read, the caller read access to the workspace) and report it to parley_scm_requests_total under the op code_index

check.pseudocode: the route added, as one row, to the table scmRoutes that the access and recorder tests of internal/scm run over, or, where the route is served by internal/codeindex, a table there {no credential → 401; a PAT without git:read → 403 insufficient_scope; a caller who may not read demo → 404 not_found; a reader → 200}; in internal/metrics/catalogue_test.go the documented values of the label op gain code_index

criteria.condition: parley scm code-index <slug> is run
criteria.action: send one GET to the status route and print the hub's answer
criteria.contract: one request GET /api/v1/workspaces/<slug>/scm/code-index; stdout is the answer as one JSON document; exit status 0; a command line without a slug or with a second argument is a usage_error with exit status 2 and no request

check.pseudocode: in internal/cli/scm_test.go, rows added to the table of TestSCM_ReadsSendOneGetAndPrintTheAnswer {scm code-index demo → scm/code-index} and of TestSCM_RefusesABadCommandLineBeforeAnyRequest {scm code-index; scm code-index demo extra}; in internal/cli/mcp_test.go, mcp --read-only --list holds scm_code_index

criteria.action: for any build that ends, count it in parley_code_index_builds_total under its outcome (ok, partial, failed) and observe its duration in parley_code_index_build_duration_seconds, and report the bytes of all trees and indexes on disk in parley_code_index_bytes

check.pseudocode: in a new internal/codeindex test file: after one complete, one partial and one failed build, GET /metrics shows 1 for each outcome and a count of 3 in the duration histogram, and parley_code_index_bytes above 0; after the workspaces are deleted and a maintenance pass ran it is 0; in internal/metrics/catalogue_test.go and test/e2e/metrics_test.go the catalogue holds the three metrics

execution_paths.title: A change lands and the index follows

steps.action: moves main, queues a build of demo, writes the tree of the landed commit and builds the index
sends GET /api/v1/workspaces/demo/scm/code-index and prints the answer
answers state ready with indexed_sha the landed commit

real_components: the code index component with agentkit-go's codesearch
setup: a hub with [code_index] and the workspace demo of the land tests of test/e2e/land_test.go, with an open change that can land
end_state: parley scm code-index demo prints state ready, enabled true, partial false and indexed_sha equal to the landed commit
the tree of demo under the data directory holds the file the change added
smoke.pseudocode: a new test/e2e/code_index_test.go: land the change through the API, poll parley scm code-index demo through cli.Run until state is ready or 30 s passed, and assert the end state

execution_paths.title: An operator restarts the hub and no index is rebuilt

steps.action: stops and starts parleyd on the same data directory
finds the index of every workspace at its head and queues no build
sends the request and prints the answer
answers state ready at the commit indexed before the restart

real_components: the code index component with agentkit-go's stored index
setup: the hub of PATH-1 with demo indexed at its head
end_state: after Hub.Restart, parley scm code-index demo prints state ready with the same indexed_sha and built_at as before
the hub's metrics after the restart show no build
turning demo's code_index off and one maintenance pass later the command prints state off and the data directory holds nothing of demo's tree
smoke.pseudocode: in test/e2e/code_index_test.go: record the status, restart, compare the status and the builds counter, then PATCH the setting off, wait one maintenance interval and assert the last end state

execution_paths.title: An oversized repository gets a partial index

steps.action: sets max_files below the number of files of a workspace
stops the build at the bound and keeps a partial index
sends the request and prints the answer
answers state ready with partial true

real_components: the code index component with agentkit-go's codesearch
setup: a hub with [code_index] max_files = 3 and a workspace big whose main holds ten files
end_state: parley scm code-index big prints state ready, partial true and a files_indexed of at most 3
smoke.pseudocode: in test/e2e/code_index_test.go: start the hub with the section, create the workspace, poll the command until state is ready, assert the end state
